description: Perform an indexability audit on https://crawler-test.com/ using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. 1) Crawl the website. 2) Once finished, navigate to the 'Directives' tab to analyze indexability signals. 3) Export the Directives data to a CSV file in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ (ensure it is the Directives tab export, not Internal). 4) Create a text report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/indexability_report.txt that includes: the total URL count, a breakdown of non-indexable URLs by reason (noindex, canonicalised, etc.), and at least 5 specific examples of non-indexable URLs found.
